verdict.rationale: Orama's docs describe a Faceted Search API that generates facets at search time from the schema, so facets come back with the query itself. The docs say users can filter results by category, price range, or other attributes, and the GitHub README lists Facets and Search Filters as core features. missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-value live counts in facet results, detail on range bucket configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
